name: Retrieve the Totem!
author: luizsantarem
description:
Challenge yourself in this amazing game!

This game was made by Luiz Felipe Santarem using FPS Microgame, ProBuilder and CodeMonkey's Key and Door System.

This is not a hack'n slash game, so walk carefully, be alert and collect health pickups quickly. 
Try to find the secret Disc Launcher and kill all enemies before going through the red door!

Comment if you made it to the end!

Feedbacks will be highly appreciated!
